messages.subject: Reverse Order an ordered variable
parts:
Hi All

I have an ordered variable "WkMuch"

> str(WkMuch)
 Ord.factor w/ 4 levels "1"<"2"<"3"<"4": 2 4 4 3 4 2 4 4 3 1 ...

I want to change the order of the categories to "4"<"3"<"2"<"1". IS there a function for the same?

I tried the revalue function in PLYR. But that did not work. 

> library(plyr)
> WkMuch_inv <- revalue(WkMuch, c("1"="4", "2"="3", "3"="2", "4"="1"))
> str(WkMuch_inv)
 Ord.factor w/ 4 levels "4"<"3"<"2"<"1": 2 4 4 3 4 2 4 4 3 1 ...

Thanks a lot.

Using the iris data set: 

factor(iris$Species, levels = rev(levels(iris$Species)))
